name: dubai-wealth-index
description: Dubai property prices, rents and rental yields from registered Dubai Land Department sales and Ejari leases. Check an asking price, compare apartment buildings, research areas, villa communities and off-plan projects, and test short-term rental returns. Every figure is dated, sourced and counted.

interface.longDescription:
Ask about Dubai property prices, rents and rental yields using registered Dubai Land Department sales and Ejari rental contracts. Dubai Wealth Index (DWI) helps buyers, investors, tenants and property professionals compare buildings, research areas and check property claims with dated, sourced evidence.

Look up a building by its registered or marketing name. Compare two to four buildings on the same bedroom type. Find buildings meeting your price, gross yield and evidence thresholds. Check an apartment's or villa's asking price against registered sales of similar units in the same building or community. Research villa communities, inspect transactions behind the figures, or review your saved buildings and what changed between data editions.

Each quoted figure comes with its source, data date and evidence count. Distinguish building-specific rents from pooled evidence, gross yields from returns after costs, and registered transactions from modelled short-term rental scenarios. Missing figures stay unavailable rather than becoming estimates.

Dubai only. Figures describe registered transactions, not live listings; an asking price is judged against registered sales of similar units. Short-term rental figures use Airbnb asking rates and stated model assumptions. Villa figures are community-level. When you want to buy, rent or view a property, the plugin can send your enquiry to Dubai Wealth Index, which replies and introduces a licensed agent, after you confirm; every other tool is read-only. It gives no investment, mortgage, tax or legal advice. A Dubai Wealth Index account is required to connect; saved-building access depends on the permissions granted.
capabilities: Building prices, rents and gross yields
Full building reports with growth evidence
Check an asking price, apartment or villa: fair range, verdict, cash and return
Check a yield claim against registered records
Short-term rental returns by area and building
Office and shop prices, rents and yields by area
Off-plan projects, handovers and developer delivery records
Your saved buildings and what changed
Request info from a licensed agent
